messages:
elena: Heads-up: planning a short docs merge window for PR #4021 at 11:15am PT. Changes: small Rust SDK snippet update, a migration note, and one link fix. Need two reviewers + a green preview.

sam: tagging reviewers now. @mike @nora available?

mike: I can take the SDK snippet. Quick Q: did you bump the crate example to 0.4.1?
elena: yes, crate v0.4.1 in the snippet. Also adjusted the example to use Client::with_token.

Doc-builder-bot: build triggered for PR #4021 -> https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/preview-4021

doc-builder-bot: deploy failed during asset publish: `403 Forbidden: upload aborted` (artifact id: 7f3a). Full logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/preview-4021/logs

nora: seeing same; looks like S3 presign expired. Retrying with extended presign TTL and kicking off a rebuild. Locally reproducing with `mkdocs build && python -m http.server --directory site 8000` to sanity-check asset paths.

sam: If the preview is blocked on infra, is it OK to merge with an infra note? Depends on risk of broken visuals for customers.

elena: preference is to avoid merging until preview shows fonts and link paths. But if rebuild fails 3x in 20m, we'll merge and add a short rollback plan.

mike: snippet LGTM. Approved. I confirmed the example compiles with the test harness.

Doc-builder-bot: rebuild queued (extended presign) -> https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/preview-4021-2

doc-builder-bot: rebuild successful  preview available at https://deploy-preview-4021--redwood-docs.netlify.app (sha: a9c4d) 

elena: quick visual check: fonts rendering good for me, images load, and the updated link resolves. Good to merge. Sam, can you squash-and-merge with the PR title: "docs: update rust sdk snippet + migration note"?

sam: merging now, using squash. Added PR body note: "Preview was flaky due to asset presign TTL; rebuild succeeded. If we see missing fonts in prod, rollback plan is to revert the docs commit and open an infra ticket."

doc-builder-bot: merged main <- pr/4021 (sha a9c4d). Scheduled prod publish.

doc-builder-bot: production deploy complete -> https://docs.redwood.ai/ (sha a9c4d)

elena: Post-merge: 1) watch for client console errors for 30m, 2) file a short ticket in #eng-infra if presign persists, 3) update the changelog on release branch. Thanks all. :pray:

mike: thanks, will monitor the Rust snippet issue tracker for any user reports.

nora: filing an infra follow-up now with logs attached.
